extraTaxes.name: Environmental Fund contribution
extraTaxes.summary: Penalty contribution of 2 RON/kg for the shortfall when recycling targets are not met (directly or via an OIREP).

notes: pro.rates left null: OIREP transfer-of-responsibility organisations (FEPRA, GreenPoint Management, Eco-Rom Ambalaje, SIGUREC, etc.) price by contract and publish no common public per-material tariff; the one public statutory figure is the AFM penalty contribution of 2 RON/kg on the recycling-target shortfall (recorded under extraTaxes). membershipRequired false = targets can be met via a licensed OIREP or by paying the AFM contribution for the shortfall.
